mapper.select: SELECT SUM(b.FILE_SIZE) FROM PAN_USER_FILE a LEFT JOIN PAN_FILE b ON a.FILE_ID = b.ID WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'
select * from PAN_USER_FILE where (FILE_PATH = #{filePath} or FILE_PATH like concat(#{filePath},'/%')) and USER_ID = #{userId} and DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'
mapper.update:
update PAN_USER_FILE
PARENT_ID = #{parentId},
FILE_NAME = #{fileName},
FILE_PATH = #{filePath},
IS_DIR = #{isDir},
FILE_ID = #{fileId},
ROOT_DIR = #{rootDir},
ORG_ID = #{orgId},
`RIGHT` = #{right},
DELETE_FLAG = #{deleteFlag},
LOCK_FLAG = #{lockFlag},
FOLD_TYPE = #{foldType},
EXTEND_NAME = #{extendName},
USER_ID = #{userId},
FILE_SIZE = #{fileSize},
DELETE_BATCH_NUM = #{deleteBatchNum},
DELETE_TIME = #{deleteTime},
UPDATE_TIME = now()
where ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM ( SELECT @ids AS _ids, ( SELECT @ids := GROUP_CONCAT( id ) FROM PAN_USER_FILE WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and FIND_IN_SET( PARENT_ID, @ids ) ) AS cids, @l := @l + 1 AS LEVEL FROM PAN_USER_FILE, ( SELECT @ids := ${userFileId}, @l := 0 ) b WHERE @ids IS NOT NULL ) b, PAN_USER_FILE a WHERE FIND_IN_SET( a.id, b._ids ) ORDER BY LEVEL, id

SELECT t2.* FROM ( SELECT @r AS _id, (SELECT @r := PARENT_ID FROM PAN_USER_FILE WHERE ID = _id) AS parent_id, @l := @l + 1 AS lvl FROM (SELECT @r := ${userFileId}, @l := 0) vars, PAN_USER_FILE AS h WHERE @r != '0' and @r is not null ) t1 JOIN PAN_USER_FILE t2 ON t1._id = t2.ID ORDER BY t1.lvl DESC

SELECT t2.* FROM ( SELECT @r AS _id, (SELECT @r := PARENT_ID FROM PAN_USER_FILE WHERE ID = _id) AS parent_id, @l := @l + 1 AS lvl FROM (SELECT @r := ${userFileId}, @l := 0) vars, PAN_USER_FILE AS h WHERE @r != '0' and @r is not null ) t1 JOIN PAN_USER_FILE t2 ON t1._id = t2.ID ORDER BY t1.lvl DESC LIMIT 1
